note: Explicit column policies for the tables owned by this module. Relational IDs/state/time are operational metadata; direct and derived personal/contact fields require subject-specific handling.

structures.OrderGuestContact: Unverified guest contact object, including email and optional contact/address keys.
structures.OrderLineTaxSnapshot: Frozen per-line tax basis/rate snapshot; arbitrary appended contact keys must not survive erase.
structures.OrderShippingSnapshot: Frozen shipping rule/address-related object; arbitrary personal keys are conservatively covered.
structures.Sha256Digest: Opaque 32-byte cryptographic digest for integrity/request identity/capability verification; never raw token, body or contact data.

subject.null_subject_policy: Unlinked guest email is unverified contact; do not associate it with a registered customer solely by matching email. A mailbox-proven customer_guest_order_links row does establish ownership.
